mechanism: Both drugs can cause hemolysis in patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, and micafungin may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing primaquine levels.
action: Screen for G6PD deficiency before use; monitor for hemolytic anemia, jaundice, and dark urine; consider alternative antimalarial if G6PD deficiency present.
